verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a Settlement Report that gives a complete breakdown of a specific payout, listing all transactions, fees and deductions, explicitly to help reconcile. It is backed by a Settlements API, a Balances API aimed at bookkeeping integration, and a Chargebacks API for chargeback details. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that refunds and chargebacks appear as itemized lines in the settlement report (only implied by 'deductions'), documentation of report export formats or matching payouts to bank deposits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
